package basispoints

// Runs ONLY in the h22-live tree, next to zz_h25_s2_fixtures_test.go copied
// unchanged: records h22's own outputs for the H25 S2 fixtures. Output path
// from S2_GOLDEN_OUT.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

type s2GoldenPrompt struct {
	Body              string `json:"body"`
	PlainBody         string `json:"plain_body"`
	Instructions      string `json:"instructions"`
	PlainInstructions string `json:"plain_instructions"`
}

type s2GoldenStream struct {
	Events   []string `json:"events"`
	CloseErr string   `json:"close_err"`
}

type s2GoldenTransform struct {
	Body    string `json:"body"`
	Status  int    `json:"status"`
	Kind    string `json:"kind"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
}

type s2Golden struct {
	Generator  string                       `json:"generator"`
	Prompts    map[string]s2GoldenPrompt    `json:"prompts"`
	Streams    map[string]s2GoldenStream    `json:"streams"`
	Transforms map[string]s2GoldenTransform `json:"transforms"`
}

func TestGenerateS2Golden(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("S2_GOLDEN_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("S2_GOLDEN_OUT not set")
	}
	golden := s2Golden{Generator: "h22-live " + Version, Prompts: map[string]s2GoldenPrompt{},
		Streams: map[string]s2GoldenStream{}, Transforms: map[string]s2GoldenTransform{}}
	for _, fixture := range s2PromptFixtures() {
		body, err := prepareResponsesBody(cloneObject(fixture.Source), defaultConfig())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(fixture.Name, err)
		}
		plainCfg := defaultConfig()
		plainCfg.ClientIdentity.PlainPrologue = true
		source := cloneObject(fixture.Source)
		plainBody, err := prepareResponsesBodyFor(source, plainCfg, conversationScope(source), persona{}, identityHygiene)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(fixture.Name, err)
		}
		golden.Prompts[fixture.Name] = s2GoldenPrompt{
			Body: string(jsonBytes(body)), PlainBody: string(jsonBytes(plainBody)),
			Instructions:      clientToolProtocolInstructionsFor(fixture.Source, false),
			PlainInstructions: clientToolProtocolInstructionsFor(fixture.Source, true),
		}
	}
	for _, fixture := range s2StreamFixtures() {
		fixture := fixture
		t.Run(fixture.Name, func(t *testing.T) {
			result := runStreamTest(t, cloneObject(fixture.Request), fixture.Chunks)
			golden.Streams[fixture.Name] = s2GoldenStream{Events: s2NormalizeStream(result.joined()), CloseErr: result.closeErr}
		})
	}
	for _, fixture := range s2TransformFixtures() {
		body, _, _, err := transformResponseBody(jsonBytes(fixture.Response), cloneObject(fixture.Source))
		record := s2GoldenTransform{Body: string(body)}
		var api *APIError
		if errors.As(err, &api) {
			record = s2GoldenTransform{Status: api.Status, Kind: api.Kind, Message: api.Message}
		} else if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(fixture.Name, err)
		}
		golden.Transforms[fixture.Name] = record
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(golden, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("prompts=%d streams=%d transforms=%d", len(golden.Prompts), len(golden.Streams), len(golden.Transforms))
}
